text: 周三（11月11日）欧市尾盘，英国10年期国债收益率大致持平，报5.224%，日内大部分时间低位震荡、北京时间17:13刷新日低至5.180%，22:00自日低附近持续上扬、23:52刷新日高至5.250%。 两年期英债收益率涨3.6个基点，报4.921%。 30年期英债收益率跌1.7个基点，50年期英债收益率跌0.4个基点。 2/10年期英债收益率利差跌3.520个基点，刷新日低至+30.955个基点。
text_en: In late European trading on Wednesday (November 11), the UK 10-year government bond yield was roughly flat at 5.224%, spending most of the day fluctuating at low levels, refreshing a daily low of 5.180% at 17:13 Beijing time, then rising continuously from near the daily low at 22:00 and refreshing a daily high of 5.250% at 23:52. The 2-year UK bond yield rose 3.6 basis points to 4.921%. The 30-year UK bond yield fell 1.7 basis points, and the 50-year UK bond yield fell 0.4 basis points. The 2/10-year UK bond yield spread fell 3.520 basis points, refreshing a daily low of +30.955 basis points.
